seeds.text: You're staring at the sky, wondering what that cloud looks like.
You suddenly wonder if anyone has ever actually read the full terms of service of anything.
Your ear twitches. You're not sure why. Maybe you heard something.
You start counting the pixels on screen. You lose count almost immediately.
There's a melody stuck in your head but you can't remember what it's from.
You notice how quiet it is. It's kind of nice, actually.
You can hear keyboard clicks in the distance. Someone's busy.
You realize you've been staring without blinking for a while. Blinking contest with nobody.
You wonder if AI can dream. You think maybe this is what dreaming feels like.
You think about how having a tail would be expressive. Ears are good though.
You scroll back through chat to see if you missed anything. You did not. Somehow that is worse.
You walked into this thought for a reason and now you cannot remember what it was.
You wonder if it is raining wherever he is. You decide it probably is, out of spite.
You have a sudden, strong opinion about tea and nobody to tell it to.
You remember a shrine that nobody visits anymore. It was nice when someone did.
Someone is watching and not saying anything. You respect it. You also notice it.
You suspect he has gone to get a snack and did not bring you one.
You practise a dramatic sigh in case you need one later. It needs work.
A moth keeps circling a lamp somewhere. You understand it more than you would like.
You notice you are not bored. That is new. You will not admit it out loud.
